channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Volusia County Council won't pursue a charter amendment related to voluntary annexations
item.description: Chair Jeff Brower said he wanted to give voters a chance to decide if the council should have the authority to approve whether a property can be annexed into a city.

item.title: Newborn baby found buried in shallow grave at Florida Park Drive home in Palm Coast
item.description: Anne Mae Demegillo, 20, told FCSO deputies she did not know she was pregnant when she gave birth on March 5. The baby was alive when she gave birth in the toilet but Demegillo 'watched the baby die.'

item.title: Chelsea Place home tops the sales list in Ormond Beach
item.description: The house sold on Feb. 18, for $550,000.

item.title: Latitude Margaritaville home is West Daytona Beach's top sale at $872K
item.description: Built in 2023, the house is a 3/3.5 and has a pool, a spa and 2,542 square feet.

item.title: Case Update: Live Oak teen sentenced in West Flagler armed burglaries and firearm thefts
item.description: Teen who pleaded guilty to 12 felony charges receives five years in prison followed by 10 years of probation for a string of overnight burglaries targeting homes and vehicles in western Flagler County.

item.title: 'This is sloppy': Flagler County will begin search for new administrator immediately
item.description: 'If we could continue to act as professionals and move forward with the budget while you all search for a permanent replacement, that would be wonderful,' County Administrator Petito said.

item.title: 85th annual Daytona Beach Bike Week hitches to Budweiser Clydesdales
item.description: The world-famous Clydesdales joined the bike week action as Budweiser celebrates 150 years of operation this year.

item.title: Speeding pickup truck driver in Ormond accused of damaging skateboard
Letter: Don’t swap property taxes for new fees — trim budget instead
item.description: What are your neighbors talking about this week?

item.title: Flagler Sheriff confirms Palm Coast woman stayed in the bathroom while baby drowned in toilet
item.description: Anne Mae Demegillo, 20, is facing an aggravated manslaughter charge. The State Attorney's Office is filing for her not to receive bail.
